decisions.reason: As a platform-fitting sensor module with some continued option value but possible overlap with more specific environmental sensing products, it is worth keeping unless demand proves persistently weak.
Because it is a replacement generation of an existing measurement module, it likely serves an established use case and is inexpensive to retain within the modular portfolio.
A CAN bus interface strengthens the platform for industrial and embedded applications, so its strategic complementarity makes abandonment unlikely unless sales are clearly disappointing.
A carbon dioxide sensor module matches clear customer needs in monitoring and automation and should remain attractive enough to justify keeping the option open.
